decisions.text: Videos will not have their own category on the knowledge website; they will be dispersed by topic.
The knowledge website will feature a school menu at the top, and the knowledge menu will be centered.
The homepage will show more articles and bring indices (like BCI) to the front.
Asia Star and Intelligent China are the top two program priorities for SEO and marketing.
US programs (Stanford, Columbia) are secondary, but Berkeley may be considered as a third priority.
Website menu categorization by topics is correct.
Only one press release for Shun Tian Shu, not two.
Media Minds likely best agency due to budget constraints.
CKGSB will sponsor Tech In Asia Conference in Singapore on September 15-16 and have a side event.
